findings.highlight: I hate things that crawl in general.
findings.evidenceJa: 基本的に壁に這うのはみんなダメ。
findings.governingReading: Taiga specifically cannot stand anything that crawls on walls.
findings.explanation: Dropping 壁 broadens her aversion from wall-crawling creatures to everything that crawls.

findings.governingReading: Illya asserts, in her deliberately dubious knowledge, that a snake is alcohol/sake.
findings.explanation: “Snakes are in sake” invents a containment relation absent from the joke.

findings.highlight: we can look forward to the 25th Tiger Dojo.
findings.evidenceJa: 第二十五話以降をお楽しみにってコトで。
findings.governingReading: The tease points to episode 25 and everything after it.
findings.explanation: The English narrows “episode 25 onward” to one 25th Tiger Dojo and supplies that label.

findings.evidenceJa: 本編でやりたい放題している悪行ロリっ娘
findings.governingReading: the evil little girl who runs wild doing whatever she pleases in the main story
findings.explanation: The English omits the main-story reference and her unchecked wrongdoing, replacing both with generic selfishness.

findings.evidenceJa: その切実な願いを聞き届けて
findings.governingReading: Having granted or heeded that desperate plea
findings.explanation: The English changes Taiga’s theatrical acceptance of an earnest plea into merely reading the petition.

findings.highlight: Please fight through the main story without seeing this devil child!
findings.evidenceJa: この悪魔っ子に捕まらぬよう本編を戦い抜いてほしい！
findings.governingReading: Fight through the main story without getting caught by this little devil.
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the concrete threat of capture with avoiding sight of Illya.
